project_identity.name: Tethran
project_identity.description: Enforceable, traceable, deliverable payments for Africa's freelancers and agencies: milestone escrow in USDT, an untrusted AI Settlement Agent, a Policy Service with an on-chain spending guard, mobile-money style payouts and NFT receipts. Built for the W3Node Node Engine Hackathon 2026, Mobile Money & Peer-to-Peer track (Tether).
project_identity.architecture_summary: Three-way separation: the Settlement Agent (LLM) proposes, a deterministic Policy Service authorises and co-signs, and contracts enforce (USDT milestone escrow, 2-of-2 vault with spending guard, soulbound receipt NFT). All chain access goes through a ChainClient interface with per-chain config. Fiat-to-USDT conversion, identity checks and payout rails are simulated and labelled.

decisions_log.decision: Vault: payees set in batches, policy changes effective at once, operator is the provider or agency admin, plain deployment per provider
decisions_log.reason: The lead said to follow my recommendation on these four unless it weakens a trust boundary; none does, though an immediate policy change means a stolen operator key can raise limits without delay (it still cannot move funds to a third party)
decisions_log.alternatives_considered: One payee per call; a delay on limit changes; platform as operator; a clone factory

decisions_log.decision: The vault authorises everything by signature and never by msg.sender
decisions_log.reason: Any relayer can submit; the keys that matter never need gas, and there is one rule to review

decisions_log.decision: One guard function serves both execute and the check view
decisions_log.reason: The pre-flight answer can never differ from what execute enforces

decisions_log.decision: withdrawToProvider ignores the limits and does not count towards the daily cap
decisions_log.reason: It is the escape hatch for lost co-signer keys and can pay only the provider's fixed address

decisions_log.decision: ChainClient asks again up to twice when gas estimation reverts on chains with confirmations > 1
decisions_log.reason: Public RPC nodes lag a block; a reverted estimate broadcasts nothing

decisions_log.decision: Helper agent commits cherry-picked onto main instead of merge commits
decisions_log.reason: Linear history with plain messages and no branch names in it

decisions_log.decision: ChainClient vault wiring deferred until the vault is approved
